champion.name: v7_sol_tabpfn_internal2_aux10

route.view: 21 raw columns + Flight Distance coarse10 (22 features)
route.family: TabPFN-3.5 in-context, n_estimators=2, int8 KV, seed 1201

aux10.view: full rich view (285 columns) with auxiliary covariate-distribution signatures
aux10.family: mean of 10 frozen GBDT roles (6 LGBM, 3 XGB, 1 CatBoost)

champion.composition: sigmoid(0.5*logit(route)+0.5*logit(aux10)), verified to 5.59e-8 against the certified portfolio

ranking_rule: expected private gain x P(independent confirmation) / (resource + deadline risk); cheap decisive tests before any full run

hypotheses.title: Low-variance composition geometry over the two certified parents
hypotheses.new_information_or_bias: No new feature: a change of combiner family (rank average, FIT-CDF quantile average, probability/geometric mean, nested weight, Platt average, 5-feature confidence logistic). It targets the 14.9% of champion failures that are aggregation losses (mass 0.0055997) rather than shared errors.
hypotheses.why_v7_lacks_it: v7 uses a single fixed 50/50 logit mean; the 0.0055997 aggregation-loss mass is by construction invisible to any fixed weight that was never fitted.
hypotheses.jointly_misranked_pairs: It cannot fix shared errors; it targets only pairs where exactly one parent orders correctly, which is where the remaining recoverable mass sits.
hypotheses.closest_prior_experiment: ENS72 covariate gating (+1.01e-5 over equal blend, could not generalise); ENS74 near-tie specialist (-1.09e-4); ENS75 hard-pair corrector (-1.31e-4)
hypotheses.leakage_risk: low: three rules use no labels at all; the fitted rules use FIT-row labels only, never the eval fold
hypotheses.validation_plan: 7 rules frozen in configs/phase24/composition_lab_prereg.json (sha 7f9c296f...), 5 primary folds, Holm over 7, gate = mean >= 1.5e-5 and t >= 2.5 and 5/5 folds and Holm <= 0.05; shadow folds 2-3 only on a pass
hypotheses.failure_conditions: any rule passing through eval-fold labels; C0 identity replication > 1e-6
hypotheses.time_to_submission: 0 (composition-only change would have been applied to the stored test parents, no model fit)
hypotheses.verdict: FALSIFIED — the deployed 50/50 logit mean is the optimum of the whole low-variance family

hypotheses.title: Segment gate on sparse rating-key rows with a smoother family
hypotheses.new_information_or_bias: Uses a label-free covariate (train frequency of the 16-column rating/categorical key) to identify rows that cannot benefit from any key-level lookup, and repairs them with one gate parameter per segment using a family whose inductive bias is smoother than deep trees.
hypotheses.why_v7_lacks_it: v7 is a single global composition; no segment-conditional weighting exists.
hypotheses.jointly_misranked_pairs: Sparse-key rows carry a disproportionate share of shared errors (atlas: port AUC 0.9503 on unique-key rows vs 0.9619 pooled), so a slice-local repair is one of the few mechanisms that could touch shared errors.
hypotheses.closest_prior_experiment: ENS72 (learned gate over hundreds of covariates, +1.01e-5); this is a 1-parameter gate on a label-free covariate
hypotheses.leakage_risk: low: segment definition uses feature frequencies only; gate weight uses FIT-row labels only; rows outside the segment keep the champion logit bit-exactly
hypotheses.validation_plan: 8 deterministic family representatives x 2 segments = 16 frozen tests, configs/phase24/segment_gate_prereg.json sha f2ab0109..., Holm over 16, same gate
hypotheses.failure_conditions: segment definition touching the target; weight fitted on eval rows
hypotheses.verdict: FALSIFIED — every candidate family actively hurts inside the slice on FIT rows

hypotheses.title: Parent-local improvement: aux10 member reweighting and TabPFN seed averaging
hypotheses.new_information_or_bias: Variance reduction inside a parent (drop a weak member; average two route seeds) rather than new signal.
hypotheses.why_v7_lacks_it: aux10 uses an unweighted mean of 10 roles; the route uses a single seed.
hypotheses.jointly_misranked_pairs: Only pairs where the improved parent alone was wrong; by the shared-error structure this is a small subset of the champion's failures.
hypotheses.closest_prior_experiment: phase-18 internal2 -> internal4 audit; phase-20 multi-seed closure
hypotheses.leakage_risk: none: descriptive recomputation of stored predictions
hypotheses.validation_plan: recompute every leave-one-out member mean and the fold-0 seed pair, then convert through the independently measured parent->portfolio ratio
hypotheses.time_to_submission: 3-5 h of GPU if seed averaging were pursued (not justified)
hypotheses.verdict: FALSIFIED FOR ADMISSION — parent-local gains are diluted to ~7% and cannot reach the gate

hypotheses.title: Census of the residual space in the 133-vector prediction store
hypotheses.new_information_or_bias: None: measures how much of the champion's error any stored model can order correctly, i.e. the headroom already paid for.
hypotheses.jointly_misranked_pairs: Quantifies the fraction of champion failures that at least one stored family orders correctly; that fraction is the ceiling of any score-level fix.
hypotheses.closest_prior_experiment: phase-20/21 blend scans with ad-hoc subsets
hypotheses.validation_plan: recompute pooled AUC, per-fold paired deltas and best single-weight blend for all 133 vectors; report the (AUC, rho) frontier envelope
hypotheses.verdict: STORE EXHAUSTED — even retrospective selection cannot buy more than +1.5e-5

hypotheses.title: New information from duplicate or key structure across train/test/original
hypotheses.new_information_or_bias: A direct label-carrying overlap would be genuine new information; a dense key structure would justify a sharper lookup.
hypotheses.why_v7_lacks_it: v7's parents never see an exact-match lookup because none was believed to exist
hypotheses.jointly_misranked_pairs: If exact matches existed, the matched rows would be removed from the error mass entirely (both parents would be forced to the neighbour's label).
hypotheses.validation_plan: hash all 21 predictors within train, within test, and across; hash the 16-column rating key and report group-size concentration
hypotheses.verdict: CLOSED — no new information source; the only dense key structure is already carried by the TE blocks

hypotheses.title: Determinism anchor: does the generator preserve the source label function?
hypotheses.new_information_or_bias: Compares the same statistic on the source population and the synthetic population with an identical key, which separates 'our model is not good enough' from 'the labels are noisy by construction'.
hypotheses.why_v7_lacks_it: No prior phase measured the source/synthetic determinism gap with a matched statistic.
hypotheses.jointly_misranked_pairs: Explains the shared-error mass directly: if two distinct passengers with identical 16-column profiles receive different synthetic labels, no function of those columns can order them.
hypotheses.closest_prior_experiment: phase-4 original_domain_audit (marginals only), phase-7 lookup probe (synthetic only)
hypotheses.validation_plan: leave-one-out group-mean AUC on non-singleton 16-column keys in both populations, plus share of rows in label-pure groups; independent source CV anchor at 130k and 65k rows
hypotheses.failure_conditions: duplicate feature vectors in the source inflating its CV (checked: 0 duplicates)
hypotheses.verdict: MECHANISM IDENTIFIED — the synthetic label function is far noisier than the source's at identical discrete profiles

hypotheses.title: Rich-view TabPFN third parent
hypotheses.new_information_or_bias: A second in-context transformer parent, but on the 285-column rich view instead of the 22 raw columns.
hypotheses.why_v7_lacks_it: The certified route deliberately sees only raw columns.
hypotheses.jointly_misranked_pairs: Would need to disagree with *both* parents on shared-error pairs while staying at ~0.9615 standalone.
hypotheses.expected_min_gain: negative to +7e-6 through the measured 7.1% conversion
hypotheses.validation_plan: would require its own prereg and shadow confirmation
hypotheses.failure_conditions: portfolio delta below the gate, as in native39
hypotheses.reason: A rich-view TabPFN is by construction *more* correlated with the aux10 parent (GBDT on the same rich view), which is the opposite of what a third parent needs. native39 already measured the pattern: standalone gain, no portfolio gain. Not a new mechanism.

hypotheses.title: Support-restricted original-row augmentation (fixing the 13.9% off-support delays)
hypotheses.new_information_or_bias: Uses the generator's training population as extra labelled rows after removing the measured off-support delay region.
hypotheses.why_v7_lacks_it: v7 uses original labels only through ogte/ogs/teach features, never as training rows.
hypotheses.jointly_misranked_pairs: Would help only if the source label function agreed with the synthetic one on those pairs.
hypotheses.closest_prior_experiment: gen84 original transfer (negative), gen85 source specialists (negative), phase-5 augmentation verdict (rejected)
hypotheses.validation_plan: 5-fold on the rich view with the added rows at weights 0.1/0.3
hypotheses.reason: Two measurements kill it. (1) The source label function transfers to competition rows at only 0.9499 AUC (gen84), so rows drawn from it pull the model toward a worse function. (2) The delay support story is refuted: dropping both delay columns from the source model costs only 3.28e-4 (0.988806 -> 0.988478), so the off-support region cannot explain the 0.027 source/synthetic gap. The remaining gap is label noise, which extra rows from a sharper function cannot fix.

hypotheses.title: raw8 native TabPFN-3.5 (H23-01, carried over)
hypotheses.new_information_or_bias: Native raw-context 8-estimator TabPFN, the strongest unresolved Phase-22 lead.
hypotheses.why_v7_lacks_it: v7 uses 2 estimators; more estimators reduce seed variance at the parent level.
hypotheses.jointly_misranked_pairs: Same limitation as every parent-local change.
hypotheses.expected_min_gain: +3e-5 at the portfolio per the phase-23 arithmetic
hypotheses.reason: T4 OOM measured: 12.74 GiB in use with 1.82 GiB free; the only fitting device is under the local GPU hardware stop. Estimated portfolio gain ~+3e-5 for >=25 GPU-hours; not economically justified even if it fit.

staged_but_not_opened.title: Adversarial / label-noise-aware reweighting of training rows
staged_but_not_opened.why_not_opened: The determinism measurement shows the noise is in the labels of *identical* covariate profiles; reweighting rows cannot separate two rows with the same x and different y. No mechanism to estimate an individual row's flip probability exists without a second independent label source.
staged_but_not_opened.reopen_condition: an independent label source for a subset of rows
